entities.summary: Grigol Mgaloblishvili is a Georgian politician and diplomat who has been Georgia's Permanent Representative to NATO from 26 June 2009 to 2013. He briefly served as the Prime Minister of Georgia from 1 November 2008 to 6 February 2009.
